slice.name: two_writer_stale_prev_chain_race
slice.purpose: Starting from one shared committed chain digest, construct two distinct complete frames, accept writer A, then verify writer B is rejected solely because its prev_chain is stale and that the rejected writer causes no state change.

mechanism_extension.candidate_construction: Both writers canonicalize their event payload, bind event_payload_digest=SHA256(canonical event), and build a complete newline-terminated candidate frame from the same observed prev_chain.
mechanism_extension.commit_rule: A candidate may mutate state only if its payload digest and commit digest validate and frame.prev_chain equals the current committed chain at the compare-and-append boundary.
mechanism_extension.stale_writer_rule: If frame.prev_chain differs from the current committed chain, reject before applying the event. No implicit rebase, overwrite, or last-writer-wins fallback is allowed.

slice.tested_scope: Deterministic small text state with two independently constructed complete candidate frames and one serialized compare-and-append decision point. This establishes stale-prev_chain conflict detection and no-effect rejection for the modeled boundary. It does not establish lock-free progress, fairness, arbitrary simultaneous network writes, semantic model-weight adaptation, or indefinite repository availability.

zero_dependency_assessment.transport_note: All adaptation/conflict logic in this slice is deterministic Chat-local computation. Repository contents API is lightweight durable transport only; optional hosted runners, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package storage, cloud credits, external model/API credits, richer-mode execution, protected authority, and manual user execution are not required. A transport rate limit remains a retry-next-invocation condition, not compute.

slice.conflict_check: No O/O-derived, downstream, other-worker, shared-ledger, other-role receipt/config, or legacy semantic input was consumed. No protected-primary or scheduler mutation occurred. Only current instruction controls, own role-local state, and deterministic local probe logic were used.

exact_continuation: Next invocation: extend the same framed hash-chain with stale-writer recovery. Starting from the state and chain after writer A, rebuild writer B against the new current chain, accept it exactly once, then replay the identical rebased writer-B event and verify idempotent duplicate handling causes no second effect. Persist exact rebase-plus-once-only evidence; do not start an unrelated base-work leaf.
